title: Dissecting Neuro-Symbolic Quality Assurance for Synthetic Oncology Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic clinical data generation with large language models addresses the scarcity that limits cancer staging research, but oncology hallucinations are categorically harmful: one clinically impossible staging assignment contaminates every downstream model trained on it. Neuro-symbolic pipelines validate during generation, yet the contribution of individual quality-assurance components remains unclear. We report three controlled studies isolating gate necessity, constraint attribution, and retrieval conditionality, holding generation protocol, diversity thresholds, and fine-tuning hyperparameters constant across adapter conditions. The symbolic gate enforces schema completeness, ontology coverage against the Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine, and staging-logic consistency under American Joint Committee on Cancer eighth-edition rules. Ungated, 29.9% of records contain schema failures and 20.1% contain clinically invalid staging. Sche

translated_title: 剖析用于合成肿瘤学数据生成的神经符号质量保障机制
translated_abstract: 使用大型语言模型合成临床数据解决了限制癌症分期研究的稀缺性问题，但肿瘤学中的幻觉具有类别性危害：一个临床上不可能的分期分配会污染基于其训练的所有下游模型。神经符号流水线在生成过程中进行验证，但各个质量保障组件的贡献仍不明确。我们报告了三项受控研究，分别隔离了门控必要性、约束归因和检索条件性，在适配器条件下保持生成协议、多样性阈值和微调超参数不变。符号门控强制执行模式完整性、针对医学系统化命名法的本体覆盖，以及在美国癌症联合委员会第八版规则下的分期逻辑一致性。未门控时，29.9%的记录存在模式失败，20.1%包含临床上无效的分期。
tldr: 本研究通过受控实验剖析神经符号质量保障组件，证明符号门控在合成肿瘤学数据生成中能有效防止模式失败和临床无效分期，从而提升数据可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study dissects neuro-symbolic quality assurance components via controlled experiments, showing that symbolic gating effectively prevents schema failures and clinically invalid staging in synthetic oncology data generation, enhancing data reliability.
